summary: Describes lig, the LISP Internet Groper, a simple tool for querying the LISP mapping database to see which routing locators belong to an endpoint identifier. It is the LISP counterpart of everyday diagnostic tools. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A little tool that asks the big address book where somebody lives right now, so you can check that the book gives the right answer.

questions: how to query the lisp mapping database
